A couple of quick questions so I can book the right person:
1) What’s your full address in Fort Worth (street + ZIP)?
2) How urgent is this?

   - Same day if possible  
   - Routine (next few days is fine)
3) When would you prefer someone to come (date and time window, e.g., “today afternoon” or “tomorrow 9–12”)?
4) What’s the best contact name, phone number, and (optionally) email for the booking?

Also, is the water currently shut off to the sink, or is it still leaking?
</action>
